parse.title: Guide:Cow's Chill Ironman Guide to Priff+
parse.wikitext:
== PVM Route Options ==

{{Checklist|title=Section 24|
* I've outlined some options below. Feel free to craft your own route.  I just offer suggestions
** Option 1: [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bow_of_faerdhinen#Charged BOWFA] Then [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Eye_of_ayak#Charged Eye of Ayak]
** Option 2: [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Eye_of_ayak#Charged Eye of Ayak]
** Option 3: [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Twisted_bow Twisted Bow] Rush
** Option 4: [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Theatre_of_Blood Theatre of Blood] Rush
** Option 5: [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Barrows Barrows] and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Moons_of_Peril Moons of Peril]
* For the rest of this guide, we'll assume option 1 as it's by far the highest quality
* Do [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Gauntlet#Corrupted_Gauntlet Corrupted Gauntlet] until 1 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Enhanced_crystal_weapon_seed Enhanced Weapon Seed] and 6 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_armour_seed Crystal Armour Seeds]
** T2 prep, learn T1 prep once you're more comfortable
{{Youtube|OxCcXZuwqno}}
* Get a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fire_cape Fire Cape].   [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bow_of_faerdhinen#Charged [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bow_of_faerdhinen#Charged BOWFA]] is ideal, but [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_bow Crystal Bow]/[https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rune_crossbow Rune Crossbow]/[https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Hunters%27_sunlight_crossbow Hunter's Sunlight Crossbow] is sufficient
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Pest_Control Pest Control] until [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Elite_Void_Knight_equipment Elite Void Gloves, Top, Bottom, and all 3 Helmets]
** Optionally complete the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Combat_Achievements Easy Combat Achivement Tier] and use 100 combat boat
* Get a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rune_crossbow Rune Crossbow] and make 200 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Diamond_bolts_(e) Diamond Bolts (e)] and 300 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ruby_bolts_(e) Ruby Bolts (e)]
* Get [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mixed_hide_armour Mixed Hide Top, Legs, and Boots]
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Slayer_II Dragon Slayer 2]
***  Kill [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Vorkath Vorkath] 50 times with RCB to get [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ava%27s_assembler Ava's Assembler]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Desert_Treasure_II_-_The_Fallen_Empire Desert Treasure 2]
*** Lamps on Prayer
** All Remaining Quests
* Slayer until 99+ and all uniques.  See Slayer sheet
** Everything below this step are things to get along the way in a general order
* Make all [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fire_of_Eternal_Light Global Fires]
* 86 Smithing via [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Smithing/Giants%27_Foundry Giants Foundry] or Gold/Mith Hybrid
** Complete Ardy Elite Diary and Western Provinces Hard Diary
* 76 Runecrafting to complete the Lumbridge Elite Diary
** You can do it at 57 with 3 Piece of the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Raiments_of_the_Eye Rainments] Set
** Optionally get 80 Runecrafting and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bloodbark_armour Full Bloodbark]
* 81 Thieving, Get 1 (2 for a clue step) [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Pharaoh%27s_sceptre#Charged Pharaoh's Sceptres] from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Pyramid_Plunder Pyramid Plunder]
* Grind out 74 Prayer for [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rigour Rigour]. Green Dragons in [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Myths%27_Guild Myths Guild] are fastest
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tormented_synapse Tormented Synapse] made into [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Scorching_bow Scorching Bow] from Slayer and second one into [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Emberlight Emberlight]
** Optional 92 Mining for better arrows 
** Grind out a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_helmet Slayer Helmet] when you're 58
** Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Monkey_Madness_II Monkey Madness 2]
* 93 Crafting & [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Demonic_gorilla Demonic Gorillas] until 4 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zenyte Zenytes] from 
** Order - [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Necklace_of_anguish Anguish], [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ring_of_suffering Suffering], [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tormented_bracelet Tormented], then [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Amulet_of_torture Torture]
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zamorakian_hasta Zamorak Hasta] from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/K%27ril_Tsutsaroth K'ril Tsutsaroth] on-task
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bandos_godsword Bandos Godsword] from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/General_Graardor General Graardor]
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dexterous_prayer_scroll Dexterous Prayer Scroll]
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Doom_of_Mokhaiotl Delve] until [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Eye_of_ayak#Charged Eye of Ayak], [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Confliction_gauntlets Confliction Gauntlets], and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Avernic_treads Avernic Treads]
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zulrah Zulrah] until [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Toxic_blowpipe#Charged Toxic Blowpipe]
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tombs_of_Amascut/Strategies Tombs of Amascut] until [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Osmumten%27s_fang Osmumten's Fang]
}}
